audits.cleanReason: All 70+ negation-bearing sentences were swept (grep for not/n't/never/nothing/nobody/none/no/nor). Sixteen have a contrast or pivot shape, and each keeps under a numbered condition: hard constraint (L25 untrained in necromancy; L473/L477 no knife), binary diagnostic (L77 chair vs stone, which Windrunner's terms pick up at L85 and which recurs at L167; L277-281 'Your lines don't spread... They close.', which sets up source vs sink; L459 tracks spread for running vs moving together, answering L457), spatial precision (L57 'not touching it'; L391 'it wasn't hers' on a spinning mare), procedural or prohibitive (L89 terms; L117 'No. Again.'; L203 'Not on the hill.'), or self-argument that the next line complicates (L51, L207, L287, L347, L499 and L503). The rest are plain negative facts with no rejected X: absence used as evidence (no smoke L323/L561, Cyndia's farmhouse report L343, the silent wood L371, no dogs L571) and result statements (L209, L243, L121). None has the 'not X. Y.' reveal rhythm, and there is no narration and dialogue pivot cluster. The keep rate is high because three prior revision rounds already removed the decorative pivots. Every remaining negation either carries a scene fact or meets a numbered condition.

audits.secondSweep: A dedicated P5/P6 sweep went sentence by sentence through all 589 lines. Roads and tracks: ran, bent, went up, ran down, following the ring, met. These are literal route-geography verbs of the 'road led' class, and none of them is carried, lit, went hotter or turned. Maps and plans: L285 'with the map already read' keeps Windrunner as the clause subject, and L297 'the lines will disagree' is a technical readings-disagree idiom in Jaina's Antonidas-register dialogue. Body-part subjects: chin, hands, stomach, face, legs and forelegs appear only in involuntary contexts (dozing L213, startle freeze L279, numbness L255/L403/L467, nausea L485/L503, flush L287, death collapse L381/L417), plus one absolute phrase owned by the main subject (L79). No abstract state settles into a body part. Metaphor chains: the 'it' chain in the contamination passages (L173-175, L227-233, L453, L495) is the chapter's literal subject (plan: Jaina sees saturation, ingress and reanimation), so the subject-matter defense applies. Instrument demotion: the sweep found one actor omission, at L293. The 'the post' metonym at L7/L477 was kept as a garrison collective whose people are already in the scene (L33 'They had everything', L125 'Someone at the post').

findings.text: The night watch at the split-cap stone, the post, Cyndia's pen, the porters at the Violet Gate, and—Light—half the people she had ever explained anything to, slowing down and smiling and picking the small words out for them.
findings.subject: the listed audiences (night watch, the post, Cyndia's pen, porters, half the people)
findings.verb: slowing down and smiling and picking the small words out
findings.realAgent: Jaina. She is the one who slowed down, smiled and picked small words for each of these listeners.
findings.reason: The verbless fragment drops Jaina, the real actor, and hangs her three actions on the list of listeners. Read as written, the night watch and 'Cyndia's pen' are the ones slowing down and picking out words 'for them', which turns the self-indictment backwards. 'Cyndia's pen' also stands in for Cyndia (an instrument in place of the person). Test: with 'she had slowed down...' as the subject, the sentence means the same thing, so it fails P10.
findings.suggestedFix: The night watch at the split-cap stone, the post, Cyndia with her pen, the porters at the Violet Gate, and—Light—half the people she had ever explained anything to. She had slowed down for every one of them, and smiled, and picked the small words out.
findings.crossCheckNotes: Negation: the fix adds no negation. Intent-smear: Jaina is the explicit subject of every action verb, and Cyndia replaces the pen metonym. Recurring tics: no corner-of-mouth, gaze, tightened/eased, shifted, weight or tag tic is introduced, and 'smiled' is a full smile, not a micro-expression. Conservative strategy (trajectory 51,13,4,4 is oscillating): the fix keeps the list word for word apart from one noun swap and only turns the dangling participles into one short clause.
